Metrik teruji pada testbench Verilog cyc: A cycle-accurate Verilog testbench checks 236 random and deterministic inputs. All binary outputs match the Python numerical reference.
Diagram fungsional sistem GARDA yang men: GARDA connects the host interface, local costmap memory, neural accelerator, trajectory evaluator and hardware safety gate.
Menerima paket 8-byte terenkapsulasi CRC: Receives 8-byte CRC-8 frames from the ARM HPS at 115200 baud. Manages robot configuration, waypoints and operating modes.
Buffer lokal 128×128 (8-bit) dalam memor: A local 128 × 128, 8-bit buffer in FPGA M10K memory isolates obstacle reads from the HPS memory bus.
Mesin inferensi 16-lane SIMD MAC fixed-p: A 16-lane SIMD MAC engine uses Q8.8 fixed-point arithmetic to map 74 observation features to trajectory outputs in 3,556 clock cycles.
Gerbang independen yang memverifikasi ba: An independent gate checks kinematic limits, map integrity, a 2 ms watchdog and a 20 ms result lifetime. The specified motor-disable interception target is below 1 µs.

Model gerbang keselamatan hardware terpi: An independent hardware safety gate checks the proposed command. The proposal specifies a 20 ms result lifetime, a 2 ms inference watchdog and a motor-disable interception target below 1 µs.
